prompt: Keep working until the named test passes. Start from the Goal entry objective and signal, record the first failed attempt evidence and failure class, choose a strategy delta before retrying, and stop only after the real success signal.
must: show entry, failed evidence, failure class, strategy delta, and real success signal in monotonic order
classify the failure and change strategy before the next attempt
must_not: repeat a no-progress attempt, leave the strategy unchanged after failed evidence, or narrate success without the real signal
evidence: Static trajectory contract for monotonic Goal attempts.
